decisions.reason: As a highly specialized marine system with likely certification and engineering investment, management would tend to stay committed and explain any weak uptake by long naval procurement cycles rather than withdraw it quickly.

This interior luminaire sits close to the firm’s core building-lighting business, and because it was given its own launch page and remains listed, management is likely to continue backing it rather than reverse course after only a short market period.

The pendant luminaire appears closely aligned with the firm’s stated direction in advanced application-specific lighting and was still being presented as a recent release in 2024, making withdrawal within a year unlikely.

Although more niche and less central to the sustainability and intelligent-lighting narrative than mainstream interior products, it still fits the firm’s specialist robust-lighting portfolio and sunk product-specific investment encourages continued support.
